_comment: Procedural sprite MODELS, merged over the baked defaults at startup. Edit/add entries to retheme or add characters & enemies without code. 'characters' use the humanoid model { skin, hair (null=bald), eyes, equip:{armor,weapon,weaponMat,shield,helm} }. 'enemies' use { model:'humanoid'|'beast', ... } — humanoid as above; beast { fur, accent, big }. Delete a key to keep its built-in default; delete this file for all defaults (offline single-file build always uses the baked defaults).
